effect.shortEffect: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.
effect.full: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

french.tid: Quand le Pokémon rejoint le combat, il absorbe\nl’énergie alentour et prend sa Forme Téracristal.

english.tid: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

japanese.tid: 登場したとき　周囲の エネルギーを　吸収し テラスタルフォルムに　変化する。
